label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User-provided Referer header flows through URL decoding into doSomething() where it undergoes harmless Base64 encode/decode roundtrip (which preserves content), then bar is written directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. The Base64 transformation is reversible and does not sanitize XSS payloads—the attacker-controlled data reaches the sink expression unchanged.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows through URL decoder -> doSomething() -> base64 roundtrip -> response.getWriter().write(bar) without HTML encoding
